newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain/German 10-yr bond spread hits record low.
newsitem.headline: Spain/German 10-yr bond spread hits record low.

text.p: The spread between Spanish and German 10-year bonds hit a record low of 120 basis points (bps) at Tuesday's market opening after hitting a record 124 bps at Monday's close.
The positive direction of the principal international markets created the conditions for narrowing the spread to new record lows, dealers said.
At 0835 GMT, the Spanish 8.8-percent bond was at 112.46/55, yielding 6.93 percent.
